description: Handwritten revalidations (#227): what a resume recorded when it claimed a woken wait, the digests of the wait's pins and of the host's current evidence, and every change with the admission or trusted layer that allowed it. cases: a wait (its run, identity, reason, pins and an approval wait's binding) and the host's current evidence, with the revalidation both languages derive (an index into items) or the refusal they give: missing evidence; a changed identity or Plan lineage (a new run is needed); a retired model (an explicit decision is needed, nothing is substituted); a changed model or reference without its exact admission; a changed policy without a trusted layer; an approval whose source, descriptor or policy changed; an admission that matches no change. refused fail the schema and both readers; readerRefused hold the rules the schema cannot state.

cases.case: nothing pinned changed; an unpinned source is no authority
a changed model and a changed artifact, each explicitly admitted
a new policy layer from the trusted host keeps both identities
a pinned source has no current evidence
a pinned identity has no current evidence
a pinned descriptor has no current evidence
a pinned artifact has no current evidence
a pinned Plan has no current evidence
a pinned accepted Plan has no current evidence
a changed source identity needs a new run, whatever is admitted
a changed Plan revision
a changed accepted Plan
a Plan where none was pinned
the pinned model was retired
a retired model is never replaced, even admitted
a changed model without an admission
a changed provider without an admission
an admission that is not the change
a changed descriptor without an admission
a changed artifact without an admission
a changed policy without a trusted layer
an approval under a new policy layer cannot run
an approval whose source's descriptor changed cannot run, even admitted
an admission that matches no change
evidence for another wait
a delegated wait under the same principals
a delegated wait under another root actor
a delegated wait under another subject
a delegated wait under the same pair of another kind
a delegated wait with no current principal
an undelegated wait resumed under a principal
evidence for another wait under other principals names the principals, in both languages
evidence for another wait naming no principals is missing, in both languages

refused.problem: a change is of a model, a reference or a policy
the pins digest has its sha256 prefix
a revalidation member no schema names

readerRefused.problem: a policy change names its layer, not an actor
a model change names its actor and time
a model change's subject is model
a reference change names a source, artifact or dialect
a reference change's values are digests
a policy change's values are digests
one change per kind and subject
